name: tarkov-performance
description: Read-only Escape from Tarkov performance skills for settings analysis, FPS and frametime interpretation, repeatable benchmarks, and controlled tuning.

interface.longDescription: Analyze Escape from Tarkov settings and user-provided performance data with four read-only workflows for configuration review, FPS and frametime interpretation, repeatable benchmark comparison, and controlled tuning. Intended for players diagnosing frame-rate, stutter, and stability problems. ChatGPT cannot access the user's PC; users explicitly paste or attach sanitized Toolkit output or compatible benchmark data. The plugin does not edit game files, automate gameplay, read process memory, or upload benchmark data.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this Tarkov Performance Toolkit report.
Interpret these FPS and frametime results.
